title: Building a grammar: a suggested order
description: This page describes the order in which linguists usually build a morphological grammar for FieldWorks, and the reason for each step. It is advice, not a rule. Motif does not check, enforce or remember where you are in it, and nothing in the window is greyed out or reordered by it. Motif has no setting for the type of language, and FieldWorks has none either. Work in whatever order your language and your data suggest, and go back to any part when a test shows a gap.
